info.name: Zebpay API Documentation
info.description:
Welcome to Zebpay!

Zebpay Build is a platform where users can create their own applications for trading like other cryptocurrency trading applications. Developers can create trading bots using Zebpay Build. Users can also build own applications (console/web/API) using our platform and will be able to:

1. Buy and Sell Crypto Assets.
2. Fetch the market data.
3. Fetch open/completed orders.
4. Cancel open orders.
5. Get the latest balance of crypto assets.

All Market and Trading related data/methods are available through REST-ful API.

  • - This endpoint provides bid and ask of the size 15. To fetch the size of 50, use the endpoint /market/{tradepair}/book_long.

item.name: Trade API
Place a New Buy Limit Order

request.description: User can place a limit order and it can be done only when there are sufficient amount of Quote currencies available in the account. On placing order, the amount of quote currency for the given pair will be kept on hold for the duration of the order.

item.name: Place a New Limit Sell Order

request.description: User can place a limit order and it can be done only when there are sufficient amount of Quote currencies available in the account. On placing order, the amount of quote currency for the given pair will be kept on hold for the duration of the order.

item.name: Place a New Market Buy Order

request.description: User can place a market order, which will be executed immediately at the current market price. The amount of quote currency for the given pair will be kept on hold for the duration of the order.

request.description:
Get Balance for Trade Pair

This request retrieves the balance information for a specific trade pair for a user.

Purpose

The purpose of this request is to provide the user with balance information for a specific trade pair. If the trade_pair is not provided, the request will return balances for all coins.

Parameters

  • trade_pair (optional): The specific trade pair for which balance information is requested. If not provided, the request will return balances for all coins.

Request Description

This request retrieves the balances of all coins for a user.

Purpose

The purpose of this request is to provide user balances of all coins.

Parameters

  • trade_pair (optional): If not provided, the request will return balances for all coins.

item.description:
This endpoint allows users to read order data, create a new order, or cancel a previously placed order.

Signature Generation for POST Methods:

The following JavaScript code should be added to the Pre-request Script tab in Postman. It automatically generates the required signature and includes the API key and signature in the request headers.

// Import crypto for HMAC-SHA256 signature calculation
const CryptoJS = require('crypto-js');
// API key and secret
const APIKEY = '';
const SECRET = '';
// Generate the current timestamp
const timestamp = Date.now(); // Unix time in milliseconds
//read boday data and pass update timestamp
const body = pm.request.body.raw
const payload = JSON.parse(body);
payload.timestamp = timestamp;
// Stringify the payload
const payloadString = JSON.stringify(payload);
// Function to calculate HMAC-SHA256 signature
function calculateSignature(payload, secret) {
    const hash = CryptoJS.HmacSHA256(payload, secret);
    return hash.toString(CryptoJS.enc.Hex);
}
// Calculate the signature
const signature = calculateSignature(payloadString, SECRET);
// Set headers dynamically
pm.request.headers.upsert({
    key: "X-AUTH-APIKEY",
    value: APIKEY,
});
pm.request.headers.upsert({
    key: "X-AUTH-SIGNATURE",
    value: signature,
});
// Replace request body with the dynamically generated payload
pm.request.body.update(payloadString);

Signature Generation for GET Methods:

// Import crypto for HMAC-SHA256 signature calculation
const CryptoJS = require('crypto-js');
// API key and secret
const APIKEY = '';
const SECRET = '';
// Function to calculate HMAC-SHA256 signature
function calculateSignature(payload, secret) {
    const hash = CryptoJS.HmacSHA256(payload, secret); // Use CryptoJS for HMAC
    return hash.toString(CryptoJS.enc.Hex); // Convert to hexadecimal
}
// Generate a timestamp
const timestamp = Date.now(); // Current Unix timestamp in milliseconds
// Access the query parameters from the request URL
let queryParams = pm.request.url.query;
// Convert query parameters into a key-value object
let queryObject = {};
queryParams.each(param => {
    queryObject[param.key] = param.value;
});
// Update or set the parameter dynamically
queryObject['timestamp'] = Date.now() // Update 'timestamp' parameter
// Convert query parameters to query string
const queryString = Object.entries(queryObject)
    .map(([key, value]) => `${encodeURIComponent(key)}=${encodeURIComponent(value)}`)
    .join('&');
// Generate the signature
const signature = calculateSignature(queryString, SECRET);
// Set headers dynamically
pm.request.headers.upsert({
    key: "X-AUTH-APIKEY",
    value: APIKEY,
});
pm.request.headers.upsert({
    key: "X-AUTH-SIGNATURE",
    value: signature,
});
// Update the URL with the query parameters
pm.request.url.query.clear(); // Clear existing query params
queryString.split('&').forEach((param) => {
    const [key, value] = param.split('=');
    pm.request.url.query.add({ key, value });
});

request.description:
Get Market Order Book

This endpoint retrieves the order book for a specific trading pair.

Request Parameters

  • Pair (path parameter) : The trading pair for which the order book is requested.

Response

The response will be in JSON format with the following structure:

  • statusDescription : Description of the status.

  • data : Object containing the order book data.

    • symbol : The trading pair symbol.

    • bids : Array of bid orders.

    • asks : Array of ask orders.

  • statusCode : Status code of the response.

  • customMessage : Custom message related to the response.

Example Response:

{
    "statusDescription": "",
    "data": {
        "symbol": "",
        "bids": [[""]],
        "asks": [[""]]
    },
    "statusCode": 0,
    "customMessage": [""]
}

request.description:
GET /api/v1/market/ticker24Hr/:Pair

This endpoint retrieves the 24-hour ticker information for a specific trading pair.

Request

No request body is required for this endpoint.

  • :Pair (path parameter) - The trading pair for which the 24-hour ticker information is requested.

Response

The response for this request follows the JSON schema below:

{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "statusDescription": { "type": "string" },
    "data": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "symbol": { "type": "string" },
        "priceChange": { "type": "string" },
        "priceChangePercentage": { "type": "string" },
        "weightedAveragePrice": { "type": "string" },
        "lastPrice": { "type": "string" },
        "lastQuantityTraded": { "type": "string" },
        "openPrice": { "type": "string" },
        "highestPrice": { "type": "string" },
        "lowestPrice": { "type": "string" },
        "totalTradedVolume": { "type": "string" },
        "totalTradedQuoteAssetVolume": { "type": "string" },
        "startTime": { "type": "integer" },
        "endTime": { "type": "integer" },
        "firstTradeId": { "type": "integer" },
        "lastTradeId": { "type": "integer" },
        "numberOfTrades": { "type": "integer" }
      }
    },
    "statusCode": { "type": "integer" },
    "customMessage": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": { "type": "string" }
    }
  }
}

The response includes the status description, ticker data for the specified trading pair, status code, and custom messages if any.

Example

  "statusDescription": "",
  "data": {
    "symbol": "",
    "priceChange": "",

request.description:
Exchange Information Retrieval

This endpoint retrieves exchange information including details about trading pairs, order types, fees, leverage, precision, margin, and asset information.

Request Body:
This is a GET request and does not require a request body.

Response:

  • statusDescription (string): Description of the status.

  • data (array): Array of exchange information objects.

    • name (string): Name of the exchange.

    • pair (string): Trading pair.

    • orderTypes (array): Array of order types supported.

    • filters (array): Array of filters including max and min quantity, and filter type.

    • makerFee (number): Maker fee.

    • takerFee (number): Taker fee.

    • maxLeverage (number): Maximum leverage.

    • minLeverage (number): Minimum leverage.

    • depthGrouping (array): Array of depth grouping.

    • liquidationFee (string): Liquidation fee.

    • pricePrecision (string): Precision for price.

    • quantityPrecision (string): Precision for quantity.

    • maintenanceMarginPercentage (string): Maintenance margin percentage.

    • marginBufferPercentage (string): Margin buffer percentage.

    • marginBuffer (string): Margin buffer.

    • reduceMarginAllowedRatioPercent (number): Reduce margin allowed ratio percentage.

    • iconURL (string): URL for the exchange icon.

    • baseAsset (string): Base asset for the trading pair.

    • quoteAsset (string): Quote asset for the trading pair.

  • statusCode (number): Status code of the response.

  • customMessage (array): Array of custom messages.

The GET request to /exchange/pairs endpoint retrieves a JSON response containing information about trading pairs available on the exchange. Below is the JSON schema for the response:

  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "statusDescription": { "type": "string" },
    "data": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "pairs": {

request.description:
Wallet Balance

This endpoint retrieves the wallet balance information.

Request

  • Method: GET

  • URL: https://futuresbe.zebpay.com/api/v1/wallet/balance

Response

The response will include the following parameters:

  • statusDescription (string): Description of the status.

  • data (object):

    • withdrawableBalance (string): The withdrawable balance.

    • lockedBalance (string): The locked balance.

    • availableBalance (string): The available balance.

  • statusCode (integer): The status code of the response.

  • customMessage (array of strings): Custom messages, if any.

request.description:
Place New Trade Order

This API endpoint is used to place a new trade order for trading.

Request Body

  • symbol (string): The trading symbol for the order

  • amount (number): The amount of the asset

  • side (string): The side of the order (BUY/SELL)

  • type (string): The type of order (MARKET/LIMIT)

  • marginAsset (string): The margin asset for the order

  • timestamp (number): The timestamp of the order

Response

  • statusDescription (string): Description of the status

  • data (object): Object containing order details

    • clientOrderId (string): Client's order ID

    • datetime (string): Date and time of the order

    • timestamp (number): Timestamp of the order

    • lastTradeTimestamp (null): Timestamp of the last trade

    • status (string): Status of the order

    • symbol (string): Symbol for the order

    • type (string): Type of order

    • timeInForce (string): Time in force for the order

    • side (string): Side of the order

    • price (number): Price of the order

    • average (null): Average price

    • amount (number): Total order amount

    • filled (number): Amount filled

    • remaining (number): Remaining amount

    • cost (number): Total cost

    • trades (array): Array of trade details

    • fee (null): Fee details

    • info (object): Additional information about the order

      • id (number): Order ID

      • clientOrderId (string): Client's order ID

      • time (string): Time of the order

      • symbol (string): Symbol for the order

      • contractType (string): Type of contract

      • type (string): Type of order

      • side (string): Side of the order

      • price (number): Price of the order

      • orderAmount (number): Total order amount

      • filledAmount (number): Amount filled

      • availableBalance (number): Available balance

      • linkId (string): ID for linking

      • linkType (string): Type of linking

      • subType (string): Sub type of the order

      • placeType (string): Type of placement

      • lockedMargin (number): Locked margin

      • baseAsset (string): Base asset for the order

      • quoteAsset (string): Quote asset for the order

      • marginAsset (string): Margin asset

      • lockedMarginInMarginAsset (number): Locked margin in margin asset

      • leverage (number): Leverage for the order

      • marginConversionRate (number): Margin conversion rate

    • reduceOnly (boolean): Reduce only flag

    • postOnly (boolean): Post only flag

  • statusCode (number): Status code of the response

  • customMessage (array): Custom messages

Example Request Body:

{
  "symbol": "BTCINR",
  "amount": 0.002,
  "side": "BUY",
  "type": "MARKET",
  "marginAsset": "INR",
  "timestamp": 1747285713470
}

request.description:
The endpoint retrieves linked orders for a specific client order ID.

Request

The request is sent via an HTTP GET method to the following URL:

https://futuresbe.zebpay.com/api/v1/trade/linkedOrders/{{clientOrderId}}

Response

The response is in JSON format and includes the following parameters:

  • statusDescription (string): Description of the status.

  • data (array): An array of objects containing the linked order details with the following properties:

    • id (integer): Unique identifier for the order.

    • clientOrderId (string): Client order ID.

    • time (string): Time of the order.

    • symbol (string): Symbol of the order.

    • contractType (string): Type of contract.

    • type (string): Type of order.

    • side (string): Side of the order.

    • price (number): Price of the order.

    • orderAmount (number): Amount of the order.

    • filledAmount (number): Amount filled.

    • linkId (string): Linked order ID.

    • subType (string): Subtype of the order.

    • linkType (string): Type of linked order.

    • takeProfitPrice (number, null): Price for take profit.

    • stopLossPrice (number, null): Price for stop loss.

    • status (string): Status of the order.

    • placeType (string): Type of placement.

    • baseAsset (string): Base asset for the order.

    • quoteAsset (string): Quote asset for the order.

    • marginAsset (string): Margin asset for the order.

  • statusCode (integer): Status code of the response.

  • customMessage (array): Array of custom messages.

Example

{
    "statusDescription": "",
    "data": [
        {
            "id": 12345,
            "clientOrderId": "ABC123",
            "time": "2022-01-01 12:00:00",
            "symbol": "BTC/USDT",
            "contractType": "Perpetual",
            "type": "Limit",
            "side": "Buy",
            "price": 45000,
            "orderAmount": 1.5,
            "filledAmount": 0.5,
            "linkId": "XYZ789",
            "subType": "Normal",
            "linkType": "OCO",
            "takeProfitPrice": null,
            "stopLossPrice": null,
            "status": "Open",
            "placeType": "Normal",
            "baseAsset": "BTC",
            "quoteAsset": "USDT",
            "marginAsset": "USDT"
        }
    ],
    "statusCode": 200,
    "customMessage": [""]
}

request.description:
Retrieve Trade History

This endpoint makes an HTTP GET request to retrieve trade history data from the specified page.

Request Parameters

  • page (integer) - The page number for the trade history.

  • timestamp (string) - The timestamp for the trade history.

  • pageSize (integer) - The number of items per page.

Request Body

This request does not require a request body.

Response Body

The response will be in JSON format with the following structure:

{
    "statusDescription": "",
    "data": {
        "totalCount": 0,
        "nextTimestamp": 0,
        "data": [
            {
                "id": "",
                "timestamp": 0,
                "datetime": "",
                "symbol": "",
                "order": "",
                "type": "",
                "side": "",
                "takerOrMaker": "",
                "price": 0,
                "amount": 0,
                "cost": 0,
                "fee": {
                    "cost": 0,
                    "currency": ""
                }
            }
        ]
    },
    "statusCode": 0,
    "customMessage": [""]
}

Expected Status Codes

  • 200 OK - The request was successful and the response body contains the trade history data.

  • 404 Not Found - The requested resource could not be found.

Expected Headers

  • Content-Type: application/json - The format of the response body will be in JSON.

This endpoint makes an HTTP GET request to retrieve trade history data from the specified page.

Request Parameters

  • page (integer) - The page number for the trade history.

  • timestamp (string) - The timestamp for the trade history.

  • pageSize (integer) - The number of items per page.

Response

The response will be in JSON format with the following structure:

  • statusDescription (string) - Description of the status.

  • data (object) - Contains trade history data.

    • totalCount (integer) - Total count of trade history items.

    • nextTimestamp (integer) - Timestamp for the next page of trade history.

    • data (array) - Array of trade history items with the following properties:

      • id (integer) - Trade ID.

      • time (string) - Timestamp of the trade.

      • symbol (string) - Trading symbol.

      • type (string) - Type of trade.

      • side (string) - Trade side.

      • price (float) - Trade price.

      • quantity (float) - Trade quantity.

      • role (string) - Role in the trade.

      • fee (float) - Trade fee.

      • feeInMarginAsset (float) - Trade fee in margin asset.

      • realizedProfit (float) - Realized profit from the trade.

      • realizedProfitInMarginAsset (float) - Realized profit in margin asset.

      • contractType (string) - Type of contract.

      • clientOrderId (string) - Client order ID.

      • baseAsset (string) - Base asset for the trade.

      • quoteAsset (string) - Quote asset for the trade.

      • marginAsset (string) - Margin asset for the trade.

      • positionId (string) - Position ID for the trade.

      • iconUrl (string) - URL for trade icon.

  • statusCode (integer) - Status code of the response.

  • customMessage (array) - Custom message array.

request.description:
Retrieve Transaction History

Description

This endpoint is used to retrieve the transaction history for trades.

Request

  • Method: GET

  • URL: https://futuresbe.zebpay.com/api/v1/trade/transaction/history

  • Query Parameters:

    • page (integer)

    • timestamp (string)

    • pageSize (integer)

Response

The response for this request is a JSON object with the following properties:

  • statusDescription (string)

  • data (object)

    • totalCount (integer)

    • nextTimestamp (integer)

    • data (array)

      • id (integer)

      • tradeId (integer)

      • positionId (integer or null)

      • time (string)

      • type (string)

      • amount (integer)

      • asset (string)

      • symbol (string)

      • contractType (string)

      • baseAsset (string)

      • quoteAsset (string)

      • iconUrl (string)

  • statusCode (integer)

  • customMessage (array of strings)

GET https://futuresbe.zebpay.com/api/v1/trade/transaction/history?page=1×tamp=null&pageSize=20

request.description:
Retrieve User Leverage Preferences

This endpoint allows you to retrieve the user's leverage preferences.

Request

  • Method: GET

  • URL: https://futuresbe.zebpay.com/api/v1/trade/userLeverage?symbol=BTCINR

Response Body

The response will be a JSON object with the following schema:

{
    "statusDescription": "string",
    "data": {
        "info": {
            "contractName": "string",
            "leverage": 0,
            "openPositionCount": 0
        },
        "symbol": "string",
        "marginMode": "string",
        "longLeverage": 0,
        "shortLeverage": 0
    },
    "statusCode": 0,
    "customMessage": ["string"]
}

The response contains:

  • statusDescription: A string describing the status.

  • data: An object containing user leverage preferences and favorite pairs.

    • info: An object with contract name, leverage, and open position count.

      • contractName: The name of the contract.

      • leverage: The leverage value.

      • openPositionCount: The count of open positions.

    • symbol: A string representing the symbol.

    • marginMode: A string representing the margin mode.

    • longLeverage: The long leverage value.

    • shortLeverage: The short leverage value.

  • statusCode: The status code of the response.

  • customMessage: An array of custom messages.

}

      • leverage: The leverage value.

      • openPositionCount: The count of open positions.

    • favouritePair: An array of favorite pairs.

  • statusCode: The status code of the response.

  • customMessage: An array of custom messages.
